title: Commit & merge
blurb: One agent on two Branches: a stale Workspace's commit merges cleanly, an fs edit of the same line makes a commit refuse Conflict until the markers are fixed in the Workspace, two Branches merge into a new one, a merge conflict is fixed on its source Branch, and the result is published.

root.note: Nothing is committed: the merge is written into the Workspace with markers. The Workspace and its Sandbox stay up for the next two steps, which fix it there.
A commit is refused while the markers are still in the file.
